test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 04 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following bodies implemented the 'UPI for International Transactions' pilot in 2025?

options.text: Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)

solution:
The correct answer is __**National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI)** is the organization responsible for implementing the **Unified Payments Interface (UPI)** system in India and initiating its pilot for **international transactions in 2025**.
 
• The NPCI launched the pilot program to extend UPI's reach beyond India's borders, enabling seamless **cross-border payments** and fostering global financial inclusion.
 
• The objective of this initiative was to integrate UPI with international payment networks, allowing users to perform transactions abroad using UPI.
 
• Through this pilot, the NPCI aimed to enhance the **acceptability and interoperability** of UPI with global payment systems, paving the way for its widespread adoption internationally.
 
• The NPCI's efforts align with India's ambition to position its **digital payment infrastructure** as a global standard for financial innovation and inclusion.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI):**

 
 
• The NPCI was established in **2008** as an initiative by the **Reserve Bank of India (RBI)** and the **Indian Banks' Association (IBA)** to create a robust payment and settlement infrastructure in the country.
 
• It is a **not-for-profit organization** and serves as the umbrella entity for operating retail payments and settlement systems in India.
 
• NPCI is the driving force behind several innovative payment systems, including **UPI, RuPay, Bharat Bill Payment System (BBPS),** and **Aadhaar Enabled Payment System (AePS)**.
 
 
 
• **Unified Payments Interface (UPI):**
 
 
• UPI is a real-time payment system that facilitates the transfer of money between bank accounts using a mobile platform.
 
• It was launched in **2016** by NPCI and has since become one of the most widely used digital payment platforms in India.
 
• The UPI system supports features such as **P2P (peer-to-peer) transfers**, **bill payments**, and **merchant transactions**.
 
• In recent years, UPI has achieved remarkable success, processing billions of transactions monthly and contributing significantly to India's digital economy.
 
 
 
• **UPI for International Transactions:**
 
 
• In 2025, the NPCI implemented a pilot project to extend UPI's functionality for **international transactions**.
 
• The aim was to enable Indian users to make payments in foreign countries and allow international users to access India's UPI framework.
 
• The system integrates with foreign payment networks and complies with global standards for **cross-border financial transactions**.
 
 
 
• **Other Relevant Organizations:**
 
 
• **Reserve Bank of India (RBI):** The RBI regulates and oversees financial systems in India but delegates operational tasks like UPI implementation to NPCI.
 
• **Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI):** SEBI is responsible for regulating securities markets and does not manage payment systems.
 
• **Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT):** The CBDT oversees direct taxation policies and administration in India and has no role in payment infrastructure development.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Collaboration for Cross-Border Payments:**

 
 
• NPCI International Payments Limited (NIPL), a subsidiary of NPCI, spearheaded collaborations with international entities to expand UPI's reach globally.
 
• Countries like **Singapore, UAE, and Bhutan** have already adopted UPI-based systems or are in the process of integrating them.
 
 
 
• **India's Digital Payment Ecosystem:**
 
 
• India is one of the global leaders in digital payments, with systems like UPI, RuPay, and AePS contributing to its success.
 
• Efforts to globalize UPI highlight India's commitment to sharing its technological innovations on an international scale.
